findings.summary: Q3 room-volume unit detaches its cubic exponent across a line break.
findings.observation: On both reviewed mobile prompt surfaces, 50 m is at the right end of a prose line while its raised 3 is stranded at the left of the following line before the comma. The native-scale written-Q3 crop confirms this is an actual pixel layout break, not viewer scaling. Desktop prompts and the mobile choice prompt show attached unit exponents.
findings.impact: The unit ending is not legible as a single attached cubic-meter expression; the exponent appears associated with the next prose line rather than m.
findings.recommendedAction: Parent should address this unit's display wrapping and supply fresh hash-bound mobile written/answer pixels. This reviewer made no repair.

limitations: This is an independent screenshot-display review, not product acceptance or approval of mathematical/source/option semantics.
No source, figure asset, native render, DOM or offscreen figure region was reopened, and no passed source/math/figure stage was replayed.
Input status fields were not used to decide the verdict; observations come from the six actual screenshots and two crops.
All 15 supplied file bindings, including display metadata, HTML and superseded mobile-answer files, were hashed only. Their contents and prior statuses were not independently reviewed.
CSS-only repair and unchanged math-byte assertions are attributed to the input/request, not independently source-verified.
Full-height mobile answers and choices were viewer-resized as recorded; only the precise lower-answer equation crop and written-Q3 crop received native-scale supplementary opens.
